summary: Validated tablet/landscape hand-fan unification and mobile/desktop non-regression for Bus'a'Lead. Across 4 viewports (900x600, 844x390, 390x844, 1920x800): page loads with 0 console errors, no horizontal page scrollbar, and the player-hand renders as expected. Tablet, landscape phone, and desktop all now render a SINGLE-ROW curved dynamic fan (all 25 cards contiguous, distinct-y-bucket count ~5 which corresponds to the fan curve, not multiple rows). Rightmost card fits within viewport width on every non-mobile viewport (tablet max_x=849/900, landscape max_x=793/844, desktop max_x=1742/1920). No element with data-testid=suit-tab-ALL exists on any viewport. Mobile portrait (390x844) still correctly renders the 4-column suit matrix (suit-col-S present, distinct-y-buckets=12).
critical_code_review_comments: Card-tap on G2's turn during play phase could not be verified end-to-end because the automated fast-speed run kept the auction alive (AI bids escalate past $65 while pass-btn under the AUCTION modal), so play phase wasn't reliably reached in headless CI. Rendering, layout, hitboxes, and query-ability of card-{suit}-{rank}-{idx} testids are confirmed; main agent may wish to add a debug shortcut or expose a scripted end-of-auction hook to make automated E2E play-phase testing deterministic.
Kitty-prayer bid>95 threshold not exercised (per review guidance) — no crash observed at any bid level reached (up to $70).

success_rate.frontend: 100% for fan-layout requirements; card-tap unverified due to test-harness limitation, not a product bug

context_for_next_testing_agent: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://pinochle-ai-duel.preview.emergentagent.com. Config screen -> cfg-speed-fast -> deal-btn. Auction modal contains Bid/Pass buttons that stay visible while AI escalates bids; clicking pass-btn alone does not always end the auction quickly. To reach play phase deterministically, may need to click pass-btn every turn while the auction modal is on-screen (poll for visibility) OR raise speed to instant. player-hand cards have testids of the form card-{suit}-{rank}-{idx}. Mobile matrix uses suit-col-S/H/D/C. suit-tab-ALL is fully removed (verified).
